# Evaluation-v3 audit fixtures

`attack-cases.json` is a non-P0, non-P1 catalog for the focused adversarial suite. The test builds a scenario-bearing synthetic 6,711-row P0/P1 chain only in guarded runtime directories, verifies both external anchors, executes every catalog mutation, and removes the chain on success, failure, SIGINT, and SIGTERM. No real review, adjudication, label pack, or anchor is stored here.

Every catalog case declares a closed classification, a required `executionPath`, and either `expectedOutcome=pass` or `expectedOutcome=error` plus one exact `errorCode`. The runner records the path from inside the wrapper that actually invokes `runAudit`, the CLI, or a narrowly classified non-rehash helper, requires exactly one observed path per independent mutation, and compares the first returned code to the oracle. The 96-case catalog executes 86 `runAudit`, five real CLI, and five non-rehash selection-math helper paths; all 84 semantic/input/authority cases traverse `runAudit`. Dataset/refined/mask/source/summary/manual/descriptor/anchor attacks rebuild every attacker-controlled pack, lock, compiled-set, external-anchor, and caller expected hash before entry. Separate post-P0 auditor-file and canonical-same/byte-different inherited-JSON swaps prove P1 reuses the verified P0 Buffers instead of reopening paths. Test-only snapshot overrides are confined to `runtime-test-*`, verify the original workspace byte hash, and replace only the source location; they never skip descriptor, schema, derivation, or anchor checks. Rehashing an attacked object therefore cannot change the expected result.

The CLI fixture policy is available only when both `NODE_ENV=test` and `SAM_GOAL_V3_SYNTHETIC_AUDIT=1` are set, and only for a realpath matching this directory's `runtime-test-*/pack`. It cannot select an arbitrary policy path. The suite also checks fixed sealed logical identities, same-buffer role/actor/hash checks, external-anchor authority, deterministic final/ancestor TOCTOU hooks, and case-by-case parity across 58 valid/invalid instances under the repository validator and independent Python Draft 2020-12 validation.
